work_completed: Diagnosed the failing Vercel preview deployment (and the matching GitHub 'Web — Build & Type Check' job), red on main since #123. Three independent causes, each reproduced locally.

1. The workspace install fails (ERESOLVE): apps/mobile pins react-native-safe-area-context 4.10.1 while its expo-router ~57 needs >= 5.4.0. Vercel's project root is apps/web, but npm resolves the whole workspace, so mobile's conflict killed every web deploy. New apps/web/vercel.json installs with 'npm install --prefix .', which installs apps/web on its own from apps/web/package-lock.json. web.yml installs the same way.
2. Dependabot #123 moved tailwindcss ^3.4.4 -> ^4.3.3 (a major version, not listed in its PR table). Tailwind 4 needs @tailwindcss/postcss and CSS changes, so next build failed. Restored ^3.4.4.

3. Dependabot #123 also bumped postcss to ^8.5.29, contradicting the security override 'postcss@8.4.31': '8.5.14' (ERESOLVE with autoprefixer). The override now reads '$postcss', so Next's nested copy follows the direct dependency and the two cannot drift again.

Type check (only web.yml runs it; the Vercel build ignores type errors): removed the deprecated tsconfig baseUrl (paths are already relative under moduleResolution bundler) and set noUncheckedSideEffectImports false, so the side-effect import of globals.css type-checks under TypeScript 5.9.
apps/web/package-lock.json regenerated with the standalone install.

web.yml's own steps also ran outside apps/web: on CI's npm 10.8.2, 'npx tsc' resolved from the workspace root and fetched an unrelated 'tsc' package. Type check, lint and build now run with --prefix . like the install ('npm exec --prefix . -- tsc --noEmit', 'npm run lint --prefix .', 'npm run build --prefix .'). The whole sequence passes with npm 10.8.2 from a clean install.
decisions_made: Tailwind stays on 3.x: the 4.x migration PR (#124) was closed, so the major bump was not intended.

The web deploy no longer depends on apps/mobile resolving. The mobile dependency set itself is left alone: it mixes Expo SDKs (expo ~56, expo-router/expo-constants ~57, SDK-51-era react-native-screens and reanimated), and choosing an SDK is Joshua's call.
decisions_pending: Joshua: which Expo SDK apps/mobile should be on. Until it resolves, a root 'npm install' (and anything that runs one: turbo, mobile.yml, root lockfile refresh) still fails with ERESOLVE.
Joshua: the 'Workers Builds: neurolift-ai-fusion' check also fails, instantly with no build step. Its log is only in the Cloudflare dashboard, so the cause is unknown here.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Verified from a clean install in apps/web, the web.yml sequence: npm install --prefix . -> tsc --noEmit (exit 0) -> npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 (clean) -> npm run build (compiled, 10/10 static pages). Before: npm install failed ERESOLVE on apps/mobile. With only that fixed, it failed ERESOLVE on the postcss override, and then next build failed on Tailwind 4's PostCSS plugin. The repo-root vercel.json ('npm install --prefix=../..') is not read by a project whose Root Directory is apps/web; it was left as is.
tests_run: Web build sequence as in next_agent_notes, from a clean apps/web install (Node 22).
